You may be going through a difficult season, facing uncertainty, or feeling weak and discouraged. But you are not alone. God promises to give you strength when you are weak and help when you need Him.

Let this October be a month of courage, strength, and renewed faith. Do not be afraid of what lies ahead. Hold on to God's promise, trust His presence, and continue to walk forward with faith.

“Do not fear... I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.” — Isaiah 41:10 [NIV]

In this much-awaited return, Arvind Swamy joins Gobinath for a deeply personal and wide-ranging conversation on life, money, relationships, family, freedom, success, failure, books, business, AI and everything in between.

From his thoughts on wealth, work and financial freedom to the things that truly make a person rich — including family, integrity and goodwill — Arvind shares a perspective that goes beyond simply earning money.

The conversation takes a deeply personal turn as Arvind opens up about loss, his childhood, family, grief, healing and learning to move forward in life. He also speaks about failure, adaptability, public judgment and why every experience can become an opportunity to learn and evolve.

He gets candid about marriage, parenting and relationships — trust between partners, giving each other space, handling disagreements, managing anger and why silence should never be used as a punishment. He also shares what fatherhood taught him and the values he wanted to pass on to his children.

And then comes the question many viewers will be waiting for:

After The Psychology of Money, what books does Arvind Swamy recommend this time ? 📚

His previous book recommendation became a major talking point. This time, he talks about the books and ideas that have influenced his thinking, including The Courage to Be Disliked, and explains why he deliberately reads perspectives he doesn't necessarily agree with — simply to understand how other people think.

The conversation also explores business, ideas, technology and AI. Arvind talks about his constant stream of ideas, his approach to building businesses, his AI platform and how technology could shape his next chapter before he returns to cinema.

At the heart of everything is one recurring idea: freedom.

For Arvind, freedom isn't simply about money, fame or having no restrictions. It is also about freeing yourself from your own limitations, confronting fear, protecting your values and integrity, and continuing to evolve as a person.

This is Arvind Swamy 2.0 — a conversation that moves beyond cinema into the ideas, experiences and values that shape the way he sees life.
